posts.title: Holiday food costs squeeze Colorado food banks as Christmas approaches
posts.description: Thanksgiving is over, but the need for food assistance isn't going away as Colorado families head into the Christmas holiday.

posts.title: Denver weather: Windy and colder with snow showers Friday
posts.description: Windy, colder and snowy conditions are moving into Denver's weather forecast, with heavier snowfall coming to the high country.

posts.title: Coach Prime firing looms as Buffs host UCF in Boulder Saturday
posts.description: Saturday, Nov. 28, could call for the end of a season and an era following reports of a possible buyout of Coach Deion Sanders’ contract, which could cost CU Boulder $25.5 million to remove the head of their football program. The Buffs will host UCF at Folsom Field tomorrow at noon for the final game of their turbulent 2026 season.
